releaseNotes:
Build 84 shares its number with Cedar on Apple devices.

- Radio: listen to stations and keep favourites.
- DTS and TrueHD audio, with a Downmix setting.
- Very large files keep playing instead of stalling.
- Live TV rebuilt around Right Now; Sports on Home with fight cards.
- Kids Screen Time and Rating Limit; Import a Profile.
- Film Strip app icons, art by armadillo.
